chunks.title: Just Climate (Generation Investment Management) (Just Climate) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Just Climate (Generation Investment Management) is a Institutional / Catalytic / Climate PE headquartered in United Kingdom. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Backed by R$870M BNDES anchor allocation announced at COP31 for Just Climate Brasil (targeting R$3.8B) + global industrial climate equity. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Just Climate Brasil targeting R$3.8B (~$670M) backed by R$870M BNDES COP31 allocation + Industrial & Natural Climate Solutions equity strategies. Source verification: https://carbon-pulse.com/571307/.

chunks.title: Just Climate Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Just Climate (Generation Investment Management) provides the following climate financing instruments: Growth Private Equity, Climate Infrastructure Equity, Natural Climate Solutions Equity. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 15,000,000 to USD 150,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Climate-Tech Startup, Growth-Stage Private Enterprise, Project SPV, Large Corporate.

chunks.title: Just Climate Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Just Climate (Generation Investment Management): Industrial Decarbonization, Nature-Based Solutions & Forestry, Sustainable Agriculture & Water, Energy Storage, Clean Transport, Climate-Tech Innovation. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, Latin America, Brazil, Emerging Markets, North America. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Just Climate Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Just Climate's application form: Climate-led investing thesis targeting highest-emitting hard-to-abate or nature sectors; Quantified GHG abatement potential per dollar invested (tCO2e/$); Commercial scale-up traction & risk-adjusted equity return profile; Strong governance & impact verification methodology. Explicit exclusion rules: Unabated fossil fuels; Deforestation-linked supply chains. Official application portal: https://www.justclimate.com/.

chunks.title: Just Climate Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: Just Climate (Generation Investment Management) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
